name: Takatsuki
type: big city; city of Japan; core city of Japan
text: Takatsuki (高槻市, Takatsuki-shi) is a city in Osaka Prefecture, Japan. As of 31 March 2023, the city had an estimated population of 348,020 in 164,494 households and a population density of 3.300 persons per km2. The total area of the city is 105.29 square kilometres (40.65 sq mi).

depictions.name: Takatsuki
depictions.text: Takatsuki (高槻市) is a city in northern Osaka Prefecture, Japan, formerly part of the Izumi Settsu region during the Sengoku period.
